Owned Java8 constructors read a same-package non-public static provider, retain
its initialization and checked cast, and delegate to the primary final-field
constructor. A second route uses a public factory; direct primary construction
is a control. Source and frozen SDK-provider profiles run the same observer.

The frozen observer checks class initialization and cached failures, runtime/error
identity, a failed cast before delegation, a primary callback that mutates the
provider after its read, escaped partial fields, callback snapshots and exact
constructor routes through reflection, two handles and ordinary bytecode. Only
owned fixture programs run. A genuine Kotlin private-object study preserves the
original concrete-provider to interface cast shape independently.
